overall.summary: The webpage demonstrates a strong visual hierarchy, clear navigation, and a consistent visual design. Lighthouse metrics indicate good overall page quality and performance, while Axe identifies several technical accessibility issues that should be addressed.
issues: Several technical accessibility violations identified by Axe
Some navigation labels could be more descriptive

visual_hierarchy.summary: Excellent visual hierarchy with clear emphasis on important content.
issues: Secondary content could receive slightly more visual emphasis

navigation.summary: Navigation is intuitive and easy to identify.
strengths: Navigation items are easy to understand
issues: Some navigation labels could be more descriptive

aesthetic_design.summary: The interface is clean, visually balanced, and free from unnecessary distractions.

consistency_and_standards.summary: Interface elements follow a consistent design language throughout the page.

clarity_and_familiarity.summary: Content is generally clear and understandable, using familiar language and recognizable interface elements.
issues: Some terminology may not be familiar to first-time users

accessibility.summary: Visual accessibility is generally good, although several technical accessibility issues were identified through Axe.

visual_accessibility.summary: Interactive elements are generally easy to identify, although some text lacks sufficient visual contrast.
issues: Some text has insufficient visual contrast

technical_accessibility.summary: Axe detected three accessibility violations affecting images, color contrast, and heading structure.
strengths: Relatively few technical accessibility violations were identified
Many interface elements follow semantic HTML practices

recommendations.recommendation: Add alternative text to informative images to improve screen reader support.
Increase color contrast between foreground and background elements to meet accessibility guidelines.
Improve the wording of navigation labels to make their purpose clearer for first-time users.
